# New Leaf Painting Co.

> Interior painting and laminate flooring installation for homes and businesses in Southern Maine. Based in Dayton, Maine.

New Leaf Painting Co. handles full-home and room repaints, cabinet painting and refinishing, trim and doors, exterior painting where the project is a good fit, and laminate flooring and stair installation. Standard interior painting includes labor, standard interior paint, light prep, and two coats on the surfaces selected.

Send room photos and measurements for a photo estimate. Photos are reviewed and the price is confirmed by email within 24–48 hours. Free in-person estimates are also available. Final square footage is confirmed at the in-person visit, and the price is adjusted to match. If the scope or condition is different in person, any price change is reviewed before work begins.

## Service area

Serving Southern Maine, including:

- Saco
- Biddeford
- Old Orchard Beach

## Services

- Interior painting (walls, ceilings, trim, and doors in homes, rentals, and commercial interiors)
- Exterior painting
- Trim and doors
- Cabinet painting and refinishing
- Laminate flooring installation (rooms, hallways, landings, and bathrooms)
- Laminate stair installation

## Published pricing (as listed on the site)

Interior painting:

- Walls: $2.05 per square foot of gross wall area, calculated as 2 × (length + width) × wall height, without deducting ordinary doors and windows
- Ceilings: $2.25 per square foot, or $1.75 per square foot when the walls in that room are painted too
- Standard baseboards and door/window casing: $4.20 per linear foot
- Door slabs, repairs, and specialty coatings are quoted after photo review

Laminate (installation labor only; materials are not included):

- Floor installation: $3.50 per square foot for standard click-lock laminate over a ready-to-install subfloor
- Stair installation: $75 per standard straight, closed-sided step, labor only
- Flat landings: $3.50 per square foot, labor only
- Winding stairs, exposed ends, old flooring removal, disposal, furniture moving, subfloor prep, baseboard work, and transition installation are quoted separately

Exterior painting and cabinet painting are quoted after review.
